name: Quai des Entrepôts
landmark: tall black wrought-iron arch with lanterns, the gateway of the flea market (destination)
note: Passage de la Brocante place 4/4; landmark: tall black wrought-iron arch with lanterns, the gateway of the flea market (destination). Last place: the passage ends at the wrought-iron arch of the flea market (B59). The board on top of the arch is blank, and the forward exit goes in through the arch. Top margin extended a little so the seal's key clears the 6% band. Last place: the far end shows the destination. No -er/-ir markers, no painted text.
